decisionSummary: The Aug 19 dev-publish v0.1.11/version-14 source is canonical. It retains the v13 source-bound package and runtime-contract controls, and integrates the four wallet-credential E2E endpoints from the only app-relevant part of feat/admin-auth-harmonize. That branch's separate static UI split and the preserved May WIP remain explicitly held for browser validation rather than being merged blindly. The Aug 14 main source is a historical-divergent baseline: it removes the current runtime contract and source-owned package controls, so it must not replace the selected dev-publish source. The remaining release/archive heads are predecessors or preservation evidence only.
